info.title: API.SH: NuGet
info.description: The NuGet API from API.SH: public NuGet data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
Package id suggestions for the start of an id, as nuget.org's search box shows them.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nuget-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The start of a package id.

parameters.name: prerelease
parameters.description: true to include prerelease-only packages.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Suggestions, 1-100 (default 20).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Downloads of a package (or one version) over the last six weeks, grouped by version, client (Visual Studio, dotnet CLI, NuGet command line and others) or client version.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nuget-download-stats

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Package id (Newtonsoft.Json), a `dotnet add package` command, a PackageReference or a nuget.org link.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: One version, e.g. 13.0.3 (default: every version).

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: version (default without version), client (default with version) or client_version.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows, 1-1000 (default 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The packages a nuget.org account owns, with the owner's total packages and downloads. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nuget-owner

parameters.name: package_type
parameters.description: Package type.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), last_edited, published, title_asc or title_desc.

parameters.name: frameworks
parameters.description: Only packages for these framework families, comma-separated: net, netcoreapp, netstandard, netframework.

parameters.name: tfms
parameters.description: Only packages for these target frameworks, comma-separated, e.g. net8.0,netstandard2.0.

parameters.name: framework_filter

parameters.name: include_computed
parameters.description: true (default) to count frameworks a package is compatible with, false for the ones it ships for.

get.description:
Searches nuget.org, the .NET package registry, by words, owner, tags, package type (library, .NET tool, template, MSBuild SDK, MCP server) and target framework, sorted by relevance, last edit, publish date or title: id, latest version, title, description, authors, owners, tags, total and version downloads, verified prefix, dates, size, links, supported frameworks and vulnerabilities. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nuget-search

get.description:
Every listed version of a package, newest first, with its downloads and prerelease flag. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nuget-versions

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Package id (Newtonsoft.Json), a `dotnet add package` command, a PackageReference or a nuget.org link.

parameters.name: prerelease
parameters.description: false to leave prereleases out (default true).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Versions per page, 1-500 (default 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
